text: Hello everyone.
We are Laplace Flower Shop.
A failed synthesis or fading battery can contain useful evidence,
yet too often it stays inside one laboratory.
SciExchange brings scientific screening, provenance,
reciprocal exchange, and human consent into one workspace,
helping useful evidence move while preserving its context.
The workflow connects numerical checks, attestations,
matching, and analysis.
A React interface communicates with a FastAPI
gateway, transaction store, and
independent signature verification.
Inspired by machine checkable mathematics, our compiler
performs numerical screening, not a completed Lean
proof.
Passing checks does not establish experimental authenticity.
Here is the actual application in demo mode.
These deterministic simulated datasets cover catalytic
kinetics, battery cycling, and a flagged submission.
Watch the real workflow.
First, compile the flagged submission.
Its reported Faradaic efficiency exceeds one
hundred percent.
The interface shows rejection, physical diagnostics,
and a quarantined prompt injection warning.
Now compile the eligible catalysis benchmark and inspect
its attestation.
Provenance connects the source laboratory, slice,
check results, and priority record.
Demo records remain labeled.
Two laboratories offer complementary datasets.
We propose a reciprocal exchange, then review exactly
what each laboratory contributes and receives under the agreement.
The first investigator approves.
Data remains locked.
One laboratory cannot authorize both sides;
a proposed collaboration is not yet an authorized exchange.
The second investigator approves;
the demo reports simulated settlement.
In live use, the gateway verifies both local signatures
before issuing reciprocal access grants.
The catalysis view shows polarization and Tafel kinetics.
This simulated benchmark reports forty two point five millivolts
per decade, with units and experimental conditions visible.
Battery cycling reveals capacity retention and differential
capacity.
Adjusting the range helps inspect changing features,
without treating a curve as proof of a degradation mechanism.
The causal warning matters.
Alkaline catalysis and nonaqueous batteries have different
conditions.
Similar patterns do not establish shared causes;
comparisons require calibration and context.
The vault gives eligible negative results another route into
circulation.
Depositing failure data earns simulated SciCredit: internal data
access credit, not cash.
In the marketplace, request access before receiving data.
Review the payment challenge, complete the simulated purchase,
then download the fixture.
Authorization and delivery remain distinct.
SciExchange: open evidence, human agency.
Built by Zongmin Zhang, Alan Cheung, and
Shaokang Li.
Explore our Apache licensed repository.
Thank you for listening.
